name: Iskusstvo novoy zhizni
source:
This is the story of Lena, whose life took a rather sharp turn when one fine day she woke up in the unfamiliar Sovyonok pioneer camp.

How well do you know Lena, dear reader? Did you truly understand all her feelings and her personality in the canon story? Her past life, dreams, and aspirations - all of this remained behind the scenes or was barely explored. The goal of this story is to create a captivating story where Lena will be the protagonist, and her past life, dreams, aspirations, personality traits, and habits will be explored in the utmost detail. This is far from just the canon plot through Lena's eyes, it is an entire story filled with a diverse spectrum of emotions and feelings.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=746232332]Steam[/url]]
